shots.image: Photorealistic vertical composition, eye-level full-body shot of a fluffy adult red-and-white bicolor Siberian cat with a thick orange coat on its back and head, a white chest, a white muzzle, four white paws and bright green eyes. It sits on a cozy wooden floor beside a small wooden advent calendar shaped like a little house with twenty-four tiny closed drawers with round brass knobs, decorated only with painted stars and snowflakes. One front paw rests on a drawer knob. Soft warm fairy-light bokeh and a blurred decorated Christmas tree in the background, cozy evening light, the cat fully in frame and clearly visible
shots.motion: From the very first frame the red-and-white Siberian cat hooks one front paw on a tiny drawer and slides it open, peeks inside, then glances left and right sneakily with its ears twitching. The fairy lights twinkle softly in the background. The cat stays fully in frame with four normal legs. Photorealistic, smooth natural motion, static camera.
shots.beat: the paw slides the tiny drawer open

shots.edit: Keep exactly the same fluffy adult red-and-white bicolor Siberian cat with the same fur pattern, face and eye color. Now every one of the twenty-four tiny drawers of the same wooden advent calendar house is pulled open and empty, and the cat sits proudly in front of it with a small pile of little fish-shaped cat treats between its white front paws, looking satisfied with half-closed eyes. Same cozy wooden floor, warm fairy-light bokeh and blurred Christmas tree behind. Photorealistic, vertical composition.
shots.motion: From the very first frame the red-and-white Siberian cat lifts its chin proudly, then taps the small pile of fish-shaped treats once with one white front paw and gives a slow satisfied blink. The fairy lights twinkle softly behind. The cat stays fully in frame with four normal legs. Photorealistic, smooth natural motion, static camera.
shots.beat: the white paw taps down on the pile of treats
shots.caption: It's not even December

trend.why_now: The weekend after Thanksgiving is when homes go full Christmas, and festive cat memes are already trending this month. Advent calendars start on December 1, so 'opened it all early' is very relatable right now.
trend.pattern: relatable holiday-rule meme: the rule in the hook caption, a sneaky first move, then the punchline reveal of every drawer open and the cat looking proud
